sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查到了她的名字，叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Weds Robbie and John Homan were a perfect match.
sentences.zh: 罗比和约翰·霍曼是一对天作之合。

sentences.en: They lived a happy and modest life in Marlowe, a rural town in the northeast US state of New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 他们在美国东北部新罕布什尔州的乡村小镇马洛过着幸福而简朴的生活。

sentences.en: The climate there suited the Homans, as 36-year-old Robbie loved the cold.
sentences.zh: 那里的气候很适合霍曼夫妇，因为36岁的罗比非常喜欢寒冷。

sentences.en: When it snowed, she and John would take their snowmobiles out through the woods that surrounded their small home, or curl up by the fire and read books.
sentences.zh: 下雪时，她和约翰会驾驶雪地摩托穿梭在环绕着他们小房子的树林里，或者依偎在炉火旁看书。

sentences.en: But their idyllic life was interrupted in early 1982, when Robbie began suffering from migraines, fatigue, blackouts, and memory loss.
sentences.zh: 但1982年初，罗比开始出现偏头痛、疲劳、晕厥和记忆力减退的症状，他们田园诗般的生活被打断了。

sentences.en: A few years earlier, Robbie had been diagnosed with a cancerous brain tumour.
sentences.zh: 几年前，罗比被诊断出患有脑部恶性肿瘤。

sentences.en: Initially, the symptoms were mild, but the tumour itself was incurable, and Robbie was aware she would eventually succumb to the disease.
sentences.zh: 最初症状很轻，但肿瘤本身无法治愈，罗比也知道自己终将不敌病魔。

sentences.en: As her condition worsened, she sought the opinions of local doctors.
sentences.zh: 随着病情恶化，她征求了当地医生的意见。

sentences.en: There was a clinic in Dallas, Texas, that was offering an experimental treatment that might help her.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州达拉斯有一家诊所提供或许对她有帮助的实验性治疗。

sentences.en: Robbie was willing to give it a chance.
sentences.zh: 罗比愿意尝试一下。

sentences.en: In September 1982, Robbie left her secretarial job to undergo the experimental treatment.
sentences.zh: 1982年9月，罗比辞去了秘书的工作，去接受实验性治疗。

sentences.en: John was supportive of his wife's plan, though uncertain when or if she would return.
sentences.zh: 约翰支持妻子的计划，虽然不确定她何时会回来，甚至不确定她是否还能回来。

sentences.en: Luckily, Robbie would be in good hands.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，罗比将得到妥善的照顾。

sentences.en: Her identical twin sister, Terry Martin, was going to care for her.
sentences.zh: 她的同卵双胞胎姐姐特里·马丁将照顾她。

sentences.en: Terry only lived a short distance from the clinic, meaning Robbie could stay with her while she received treatment in Texas.
sentences.zh: 特里住的地方离诊所很近，这意味着罗比在得克萨斯州接受治疗期间可以和她住在一起。

sentences.en: Months passed, and the treatment proved unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，治疗证明并没有成功。

sentences.en: As Robbie's hopes for survival dwindled, she wrote a letter to her sister stipulating her wishes in the event of her passing.
sentences.zh: 随着罗比对生存的希望逐渐渺茫，她给姐姐写了一封信，交代了自己去世后的遗愿。

sentences.en: I'm afraid I won't make it home, it read.
sentences.zh: 信中写道，恐怕我回不了家了。

sentences.en: I want so much to see my John again, and I know you have been torn between my wishes and what you feel is right, but I don't want him to see me like this.
sentences.zh: 我太想再次见到我的约翰了，我知道你一直在我的愿望和你认为正确的事情之间左右为难，但我不想让他看到我这个样子。

sentences.en: I'm trying to hold on until December, but though my mind tells me not to give in, my body is too tired to listen.
sentences.zh: 我正努力撑到12月，但尽管我的理智告诉我不要放弃，我的身体却太累了，不听使唤。

sentences.en: Robbie went on to apologise for any hardship Terry had endured in caring for her and expressed gratitude for how wonderful her sister had been.
sentences.zh: 罗比接着为特里在照顾她期间所承受的艰难困苦表示道歉，并对姐姐无微不至的照顾表达了感激之情。

sentences.en: She wrote of her love for Terry, as well as John, adding,
sentences.zh: 她写下了对特里以及对约翰的爱，并补充道：

sentences.en: I hope I will wake up one morning and everything will be better, but this is just in case things go wrong.
sentences.zh: 我希望有一天早上醒来，一切都会好起来，但这是以防万一事情出了差错。

sentences.en: There is to be no funerals or memorials.
sentences.zh: 不要举行葬礼或追悼会。

sentences.en: I don't want either of you to waste time grieving for me.
sentences.zh: 我不想你们任何一个人浪费时间为我悲伤。

sentences.en: Life is too valuable, and it doesn't last that long.
sentences.zh: 生命太宝贵了，而且并不那么长久。

sentences.en: Time is a slow healer, but I know that eventually it does heal.
sentences.zh: 时间是缓慢的治愈者，但我知道它最终确实会治愈一切。

sentences.en: Just keep that in mind, Terry.
sentences.zh: 把这点记在心里，特里。

sentences.en: Everything passes.
sentences.zh: 一切都会过去的。

sentences.en: Just please take care of John.
sentences.zh: 请务必照顾好约翰。

sentences.en: Robbie wrote the date at the top of the page.
sentences.zh: 罗比在纸的顶部写下了日期。

sentences.en: November 10, 1982.
She died the next day.
sentences.zh: 她于第二天去世。

sentences.en: The following day, John Homan stood alone at Boston Airport.
sentences.zh: 第二天，约翰·霍曼独自一人站在波士顿机场。

sentences.en: Terry Martin was now en route from Texas to meet with him, as per Robbie's wishes.
sentences.zh: 遵照罗比的遗愿，特里·马丁当时正从得克萨斯州赶来与他会面。

sentences.en: Because they lived so far apart, John had never met Terry before, but knew she and Robbie had been close.
sentences.zh: 因为两人住得很远，约翰以前从未见过特里，但知道她和罗比关系密切。

sentences.en: The twins wrote to each other often and spoke on the phone nearly every day.
sentences.zh: 这对双胞胎经常给对方写信，几乎每天都通电话。

sentences.en: In the letter Robbie wrote prior to her passing, she expressed her hope that Terry would one day be friends with John.
sentences.zh: 在罗比去世前写的那封信中，她表达了希望特里有一天能和约翰成为朋友的愿望。

sentences.en: Adding,
sentences.zh: 并补充说：

sentences.en: If it doesn't upset John too much, please stay with him as long as he needs you.
sentences.zh: 如果这不会让约翰太难过，请在他需要的时候陪着他。

sentences.en: He is so kind, and you need a friend like him, and I think he will need you.
sentences.zh: 他那么善良，你需要一个像他这样的朋友，而且我想他也会需要你。

sentences.en: When John saw Terry for the first time, he was brought to tears.
sentences.zh: 当约翰第一次见到特里时，他感动得流下了眼泪。

sentences.en: While Terry had a slimmer build than Robbie and her hair was blonde, the resemblance was still uncanny.
sentences.zh: 虽然特里的身材比罗比苗条，头发也是金色的，但两人的相像程度仍然惊人。

sentences.en: At John's invitation, Terry decided to stay with him in the home he had once shared with Robbie.
sentences.zh: 应约翰的邀请，特里决定和他一起住在曾经与罗比共同度过的家里。

sentences.en: The pair then visited the office of the county newspaper.
sentences.zh: 随后两人拜访了县报社的办公室。

sentences.en: Terry tearfully handed over a piece of paper to the editorial assistant, explaining that she needed to have an obituary printed.
sentences.zh: 特里含泪将一张纸递给编辑助理，解释说她需要刊登一则讣告。

sentences.en: Terry explained that her sister hadn't gone to a funeral home.
sentences.zh: 特里解释说，她的姐姐没有去殡仪馆。

sentences.en: Robbie had requested that her remains be donated for medical research.
sentences.zh: 罗比曾请求将她的遗体捐献用于医学研究。

sentences.en: Robbie Homan's obituary was printed the following day.
sentences.zh: 罗比·霍曼的讣告于次日刊登。

sentences.en: When employees at the office where Robbie had worked read it, they were shocked.
sentences.zh: 罗比生前工作办公室的员工读到这则讣告时，都震惊了。

sentences.en: This was the first they had heard that she'd died.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次听说她去世的消息。

sentences.en: Robbie had given the impression that she would eventually return to work, and even left her belongings behind.
sentences.zh: 罗比曾给人一种她最终会回到工作岗位的印象，甚至留下了她的私人物品。

sentences.en: A framed photograph of John still sat on her desk.
sentences.zh: 约翰的一张镶框照片依然静静地摆在她的办公桌上。

sentences.en: Yet, Robbie's boss had seen the toll that her brain tumour took on her in the months before she left for Dallas.
sentences.zh: 然而，罗比的老板在罗比前往达拉斯之前的几个月里，已经目睹了脑肿瘤对她造成的折磨。

sentences.en: Her warm and bubbly personality faded as she was overcome with pain.
sentences.zh: 随着她被病痛击垮，她那热情洋溢的个性逐渐消逝。

sentences.en: Her face grew gaunt.
sentences.zh: 她的脸变得消瘦。

sentences.en: Dark rings formed under her eyes, and she was sometimes seen crying.
sentences.zh: 她的眼眶凹陷，有时还会被人看到在哭泣。

sentences.en: When her boss learnt of Robbie's passing, he thought it was, quote,
sentences.zh: 当她的老板得知罗比去世的消息时，他认为，原话是：

sentences.en: A rotten thing, but probably the best for her.
sentences.zh: 这真是一件糟糕的事，但对她来说可能是最好的结果。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Terry Martin settled in with her brother-in-law, John Homan.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特里·马丁在她的连襟约翰·霍曼家安顿了下来。

sentences.en: Before long, she had seemingly taken Robbie's place.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，她似乎就取代了罗比的位置。

sentences.en: When Terry expressed plans to permanently relocate to Marlowe to live with John, his family were confused.
sentences.zh: 当特里表达计划永久搬到马洛与约翰同住时，他的家人感到很困惑。

sentences.en: But John made it clear that they had a purely platonic friendship founded on their mutual grief over Robbie's death.
sentences.zh: 但约翰明确表示，他们之间建立在对罗比离世共同悲痛之上的纯粹是柏拉图式的友谊。

sentences.en: Terry wasn't like Robbie anyway.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，特里和罗比并不一样。

sentences.en: John Homan was an introvert with few friends, matching Robbie, who was quiet and reserved.
sentences.zh: 约翰·霍曼是个内向的人，朋友很少，这与性格安静内向的罗比很合拍。

sentences.en: Those who met Terry found her talkative and outgoing.
sentences.zh: 那些见过特里的人发现她健谈而且外向。

sentences.en: Terry also spent her spare time watching television, while Robbie had hated TV and preferred to read.
sentences.zh: 特里还把闲暇时间都用来看电视，而罗比则讨厌电视并更喜欢读书。

sentences.en: Despite these differences, Terry said she and her twin sister had shared a special bond.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在这些差异，特里表示她和她的双胞胎姐姐有着特殊的纽带。

sentences.en: They could sense when the other was in emotional or physical pain.
sentences.zh: 当另一个人处于情感或身体痛苦中时，她们能感觉得到。

sentences.en: She remarked that losing Robbie was like having a part of you, Di.
sentences.zh: 她评论说失去罗比就像身体的一部分被剥离了一样。

sentences.en: Like Robbie, Terry was a trained secretary and wanted to find a job so she could contribute to her and John's living costs.
sentences.zh: 和罗比一样，特里也是一名受过培训的秘书，想找一份工作，以便分担她和约翰的生活费用。

sentences.en: John suggested that she visit the same employment agency that had secured a position for Robbie.
sentences.zh: 约翰建议她去那家曾为罗比安排过工作的职介所看看。

sentences.en: Terry agreed, and although she didn't perform as well on the typing and shorthand test as her sister had, she found a job as an executive secretary at a book printer.
sentences.zh: 特里表示同意，尽管她在打字和速记测试中的表现不如她姐姐那样出色，但她还是在一家图书印刷厂找到了一份行政秘书的工作。

sentences.en: She soon paid a visit to her sister's former employer.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，她拜访了姐姐以前的雇主。

sentences.en: Terry walked into the office with John and introduced herself to the staff.
sentences.zh: 特里和约翰一起走进办公室，向工作人员做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: They were stunned, as they had no idea that Robbie's twin was now living in Marlow.
sentences.zh: 他们惊呆了，因为他们根本不知道罗比的双胞胎姐妹现在住在马洛。

sentences.en: One of Robbie's best friends showed Terry around, pointing out the desk where Robbie had worked.
sentences.zh: 罗比的一位好朋友带着特里参观，指出了罗比曾经工作过的办公桌。

sentences.en: An employee named Sandra missed Terry as she toured the building, but caught up with her just as she was saying goodbye.
sentences.zh: 一名叫桑德拉的员工在特里参观大楼时错过了她，但在她正要告别时追上了她。

sentences.en: Sandra asked her colleagues what was going on.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉问她的同事发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Another woman filled her in, saying,
sentences.zh: 另一名女子向她透露说：

sentences.en: That's Robbie's twin sister, Terry Martin.
sentences.zh: 那是罗比的双胞胎姐姐，特里·马丁。

sentences.en: She wanted to see where Robbie worked.
sentences.zh: 她想来看看罗比工作过的地方。

sentences.en: In response, Sandra exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 对此，桑德拉大声惊呼：

sentences.en: Bullshit.
sentences.zh: 胡说八道。

sentences.en: That's Robbie.
sentences.zh: 那就是罗比。

sentences.en: Rumours ran rife amongst Robbie's former co-workers that Terry was actually Robbie pretending to be her own twin.
sentences.zh: 罗比的前同事中流传着各种谣言，称特里其实就是罗比，在假装成自己的双胞胎姐妹。

sentences.en: Although Terry was slimmer than Robbie had been, there was no denying that she had the same voice.
sentences.zh: 虽然特里比生前的罗比更苗条，但不可否认她有着相同的声音。

sentences.en: She also had her sister's intelligence and quick wit.
sentences.zh: 她还拥有姐姐的聪慧和机智。

sentences.en: Terry's hair was not naturally blonde, but had been bleached, fuelling further speculation that she was Robbie in disguise.
sentences.zh: 特里的头发不是天生金发，而是漂染的，这进一步助长了她是罗比乔装打扮的猜测。

sentences.en: Others, including Robbie's former boss, found the idea preposterous.
sentences.zh: 其他人，包括罗比的前老板，则认为这种想法荒谬绝伦。

sentences.en: He urged his employees to stop gossiping and to let Robbie Homan rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 他敦促员工们停止八卦，让罗比·霍曼安息吧。

sentences.en: It wasn't just Robbie's former colleagues who thought Terry was an imposter.
sentences.zh: 不仅罗比的前同事认为特里是个冒名顶替者。

sentences.en: John Homan's friends had also noticed the bizarre similarities between Robbie and Terry.
sentences.zh: 约翰·霍曼的朋友们也注意到了罗比和特里之间离奇的相似之处。

sentences.en: Terry chain-smoked the same uncommon brand of cigarette that her sister had, and their handwriting was similar.
sentences.zh: 特里连续抽着她姐姐生前抽的那种罕见品牌的香烟，而且她们的笔迹也很相似。

sentences.en: Terry, like Robbie, didn't drink alcohol.
sentences.zh: 特里和罗比一样，不喝酒。

sentences.en: Both women also had gold caps on the same teeth.
sentences.zh: 两名女性的相同牙齿上也都有金牙冠。

sentences.en: One of John's friends broached the sensitive topic with him.
sentences.zh: 约翰的一位朋友向他抛出了这个敏感的话题。

sentences.en: John listened respectfully, but dismissed his friends' concerns.
sentences.zh: 约翰恭敬地听着，但打消了朋友们的顾虑。

sentences.en: He knew his wife better than anyone.
sentences.zh: 他比任何人都了解自己的妻子。

sentences.en: There was no doubt in his mind that Robbie had died and Terry Martin was her twin sister.
sentences.zh: 他坚信罗比已经去世，特里·马丁确实是她的双胞胎姐姐。

sentences.en: Some of Robbie's former colleagues went on a mission to uncover the truth.
sentences.zh: 罗比的一些前同事踏上了揭开真相的征程。

sentences.en: One re-read Robbie's obituary and noticed it listed her full name as Robbie L.
sentences.zh: 其中一人重读了罗比的讣告，发现上面列出的全名是罗比·L。

sentences.en: Homan.
sentences.zh: ·霍曼。

sentences.en: This employee worked in personnel, so she knew that Robbie actually went by her middle name.
sentences.zh: 这名员工在人事部门工作，所以她知道罗比其实一直使用的是她的中间名。

sentences.en: Her full name was Lindsay Robbie Homan.
sentences.zh: 她的全名是林赛·罗比·霍曼。

sentences.en: Other sceptics phoned various hospitals to find the facility that Robbie's body had been donated to.
sentences.zh: 其他怀疑论者打电话给各大医院，试图找出罗比遗体捐赠的机构。

sentences.en: It was listed in her obituary as the Medical Research Institute in Texas, but no such place existed.
sentences.zh: 讣告中将其列为得克萨斯州的医学研究所，但根本没有这样一个地方。

sentences.en: Robbie's obituary also mentioned that she had been a member of the Sacred Heart Church in the Texan city of Tyler.
sentences.zh: 罗比的讣告还提到她曾是得克萨斯州泰勒市圣心教堂的教友。

sentences.en: But Tyler had no church by that name.
sentences.zh: 但泰勒市并没有叫这个名字的教堂。

sentences.en: The county police were notified of the goings-on and were intrigued.
sentences.zh: 县警察局收到了这些情况的通报，并对此产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: One detective started checking births, deaths and marriages records for documentation regarding Robbie's passing in Texas.
sentences.zh: 一名侦探开始查阅出生、死亡和结婚记录，寻找关于罗比在得克萨斯州去世的文献证明。

sentences.en: He didn't find any.
sentences.zh: 他没有找到任何记录。

sentences.en: The obituary also mentioned that Robbie and Terry had been born in 1945 to Hugh and Cindy Grayson in Albany, New York.
sentences.zh: 讣告中还提到，罗比和特里于1945年出生于纽约州奥尔巴尼，父母是休和辛迪·格雷森。

sentences.en: There were no birth records that matched this information.
sentences.zh: 没有任何出生记录与此信息相符。

sentences.en: It begged the question, if Robbie Homan and Terry Martin never existed, then who was the woman living with John Homan?
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一个问题：如果罗比·霍曼和特里·马丁从未存在过，那么和约翰·霍曼住在一起的女人到底是谁？

sentences.en: Seven years earlier and 1,000 miles away, a man named Frank Hilly fell ill.
sentences.zh: 七年前，在1000英里之外，一个名叫弗兰克·希利的男子生病了。

sentences.en: Frank lived in the town of Anniston in the southeastern state of Alabama, where he worked as a shipping director at a factory.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克住在东南部阿拉巴马州的安尼斯顿镇，他在一家工厂担任发货主管。

sentences.en: What had started as regular headaches gradually progressed to pain so intense, the 45-year-old was often left in tears.
sentences.zh: 原本规律的头痛逐渐恶化为剧烈的疼痛，让这位45岁的男子常常泪流满面。

sentences.en: Frank went from being good-natured and happy-go-lucky to quiet and withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克从一个性格随和、乐天派的人变得沉默寡言、离群索居。

sentences.en: Then, on Friday, May 16, 1975, he suffered severe stomach cramps while at work.
sentences.zh: 然后，在1975年5月16日星期五，他在工作时突发严重的胃痉挛。

sentences.en: Believing he was burned out, Frank excused himself and went home to recover.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克认为自己是累垮了，便请假回家休养。

sentences.en: Later that day, Frank developed chills and a fever.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，弗兰克开始出现寒战和发烧。

sentences.en: His wife, Marie, called Frank's doctor, who recommended he take aspirin and drink fluids.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子玛丽打电话给弗兰克的医生，医生建议他服用阿司匹林并多喝水。

sentences.en: This did little to help.
sentences.zh: 这并没有起到什么作用。

sentences.en: Frank's symptoms intensified over the weekend, culminating in nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea.
sentences.zh: 整个周末，弗兰克的症状不断加剧，并最终出现恶心、呕吐和腹泻。

sentences.en: By Monday, Frank's fever had subsided, but he was still suffering abdominal pain.
sentences.zh: 到了星期一，弗兰克的高烧已经消退，但他仍然饱受腹痛折磨。

sentences.en: He was diagnosed with stomach flu and prescribed medication to help his digestive system.
sentences.zh: 他被诊断为肠胃性感冒，并被开具了帮助消化系统恢复的药物。

sentences.en: News of Frank's illness spread through his workplace.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克生病的消息在他的工作场所传开了。

sentences.en: Colleagues noted that his condition arose after a new drinking water system was installed at the factory.
sentences.zh: 同事们注意到，他的病情是在工厂安装了新的饮用水系统之后出现的。

sentences.en: They worried the supply had been contaminated with wastewater from the shop floor.
sentences.zh: 他们担心水源被车间的废水污染了。

sentences.en: Staff were ordered to bring bottled water from home until tests confirmed it was safe to drink.
sentences.zh: 员工们被勒令从家里带瓶装水，直到测试证实水质可以安全饮用为止。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a week resting at home did not help Frank Hilly.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在家休养了一周并没有让弗兰克·希利好转。

sentences.en: At 3.30am on Friday, May 23, Marie woke to find her husband's side of the bed empty.
sentences.zh: 5月23日星期五凌晨3点30分，玛丽醒来发现丈夫那一边的床是空的。

sentences.en: She searched the house and after finding no sign of him, Marie went outside.
sentences.zh: 她在屋里到处寻找，在没有发现他的踪迹后，玛丽走到了外面。

sentences.en: Frank was in their front yard, wearing nothing but his underwear.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克正站在他们家的前院里，身上只穿着内衣。

sentences.en: He appeared confused as he wandered about aimlessly.
sentences.zh: 他漫无目的地四处游荡，显得十分迷茫。

sentences.en: When Marie called out to Frank, he turned to her and asked,
sentences.zh: 当玛丽大声呼唤弗兰克时，他转过身问她：

sentences.en: Where's the car?
sentences.zh: 车呢？

sentences.en: It then became clear to Marie that her husband of 25 years no longer recognised her.
sentences.zh: 玛丽随后意识到，她结婚25年的丈夫已经认不出她了。

sentences.en: She rushed Frank to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她急忙把弗兰克送到医院。

sentences.en: By this time, his skin had turned yellow and he had little energy to move.
sentences.zh: 此时，他的皮肤已经变黄，几乎没有力气移动。

sentences.en: Frank's delirium also worsened.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克的谵妄状态也恶化了。

sentences.en: At one point, he picked up an imaginary pen to write on his bedsheets, thinking he was sitting at his office desk.
sentences.zh: 有一刻，他拿起一支想象中的笔在床单上写字，以为自己正坐在办公室的桌前。

sentences.en: Marie called their 22-year-old son, Mike, who lived interstate.
sentences.zh: 玛丽给他们22岁的儿子迈克打了电话，迈克住在外州。

sentences.en: The doctors can't seem to do anything for Frank.
sentences.zh: 医生们似乎对弗兰克束手无策。

sentences.en: Marie told Mike.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉了迈克。

sentences.en: If he doesn't get well, he's going to die.
sentences.zh: 如果他的病不见好，他就会死。

sentences.en: Mike arrived at the hospital two days later.
sentences.zh: 两天后，迈克赶到了医院。

sentences.en: He went into Frank's room to find his mother sleeping in a chair and his father still lying in bed.
sentences.zh: 他走进弗兰克的病房，发现母亲在椅子上睡着了，父亲仍然躺在床上。

sentences.en: Mike suddenly realised his father had passed away in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 迈克突然意识到，父亲在睡梦中已经去世了。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed that Frank died from kidney failure, believed to have been caused by infectious hepatitis.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，弗兰克死于肾衰竭，据信是由传染性肝炎引起的。

sentences.en: It was unknown how Frank might have caught the virus.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚弗兰克是如何感染这种病毒的。

sentences.en: His funeral was held two days after his death.
sentences.zh: 他的葬礼在他去世两天后举行。

sentences.en: Days later, Marie Hilly started receiving threats.
sentences.zh: 几天后，玛丽·希利开始接到威胁。

sentences.en: It began with phone calls to the Hilly home.
sentences.zh: 最初是打到希利家里的电话。

sentences.en: The caller would immediately hang up when Marie answered.
sentences.zh: 玛丽一接听，对方就会立刻挂断。

sentences.en: Other times, they'd stay on the line but remained silent.
sentences.zh: 有时，对方会在线上却保持沉默。

sentences.en: Marie spoke of sensing that someone had been in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说她感觉到后院曾有人来过。

sentences.en: Then one day, she arrived home to discover some meat she'd left out to Thor had been moved.
sentences.zh: 接着有一天，她回到家，发现她留给狗托尔吃的一块肉被移位了。

sentences.en: Nothing else appeared missing or out of place.
sentences.zh: 没有发现其他东西丢失或错位。

sentences.en: Mike Hilly had to make a three-hour round trip to Aniston to comfort his mother and his 14-year-old sister, Carol.
sentences.zh: 迈克·希利不得不往返安尼斯顿三个小时，去安慰他的母亲和14岁的妹妹卡罗尔。

sentences.en: However, the Hilly's weren't the only ones targeted.
sentences.zh: 然而，成为目标的并非只有希利一家。

sentences.en: Their neighbour, a woman named Doris Ford, was also receiving nuisance phone calls and thought an intruder had entered her property.
sentences.zh: 他们的邻居多丽丝·福特也接到了骚扰电话，并认为有入侵者闯入了她的地产。

sentences.en: Then, just over three months after Frank's death, Doris noticed thick smoke billowing from the Hilly residence.
sentences.zh: 随后，在弗兰克去世三个多月后，多丽丝注意到希利家冒起了滚滚浓烟。

sentences.en: Marie Hilly's mother had recently moved into the home following a cancer diagnosis and there were concerns she might be trapped in the burning building.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利的母亲最近因被诊断患有癌症而搬进了这个家，人们担心她可能会被困在着火的建筑里。

sentences.en: Just as firefighters readied themselves to rescue her, Marie and her mother drove up to the house.
sentences.zh: 正当消防员准备营救她时，玛丽和她的母亲开车回到了房子前。

sentences.en: They had been out running an errand.
sentences.zh: 她们刚刚外出办事回来。

sentences.en: The fire was extinguished before it inflicted any serious damage.
sentences.zh: 火灾在造成严重破坏之前就被扑灭了。

sentences.en: A month later, Marie phoned the police after smelling gas in her house.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，玛丽闻到家里有煤气味，便报了警。

sentences.en: An officer arrived but was unable to find evidence of a leak.
sentences.zh: 一名警官赶到，但未能找到泄漏的证据。

sentences.en: Next door, the gas at Doris Ford's house had also been meddled with.
sentences.zh: 隔壁多丽丝·福特家的煤气也被动了手脚。

sentences.en: She'd noticed the switch on her outdoor grill had been turned to the highest setting.
sentences.zh: 她注意到她室外烤炉的开关被扭到了最高档。

sentences.en: Following this incident, Marie Hilly received another phone call.
sentences.zh: 这起事件发生后，玛丽·希利又接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: This time, a man breathed heavily into the receiver and said,
sentences.zh: 这一次，一个男人在听筒里重重地喘着粗气，说道：

sentences.en: Over the next few months, Marie and Doris endured more attacks on their homes.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，玛丽和多丽丝的家又遭到了更多的袭击。

sentences.en: Windows were smashed and their screens slashed.
sentences.zh: 窗户被砸碎，纱窗被划破。

sentences.en: One night, Marie came home to find someone had broken in and stolen expensive jewellery and a handgun.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，玛丽回到家，发现有人入室盗窃，偷走了昂贵的珠宝和一把手枪。

sentences.en: She believed the culprit was an 18-year-old who lived in the street.
sentences.zh: 她认为罪魁祸首是一个住在街上的18岁年轻人。

sentences.en: Police ruled him out.
sentences.zh: 警方排除了他的嫌疑。

sentences.en: By mid-1977, Frank Hilly had been dead for two years, but his family was still being harassed.
sentences.zh: 到1977年中期，弗兰克·希利已经去世两年了，但他的家人仍在遭受骚扰。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Friday July 22, Marie woke to the smell of smoke.
sentences.zh: 7月22日星期五清晨，玛丽在烟味中醒来。

sentences.en: A small fire was burning in the downstairs hallway closet.
sentences.zh: 楼下走廊的壁橱里有一场小火正在燃烧。

sentences.en: Marie managed to extinguish it before it took hold.
sentences.zh: 玛丽在火势蔓延之前设法将其扑灭了。

sentences.en: Two days later, Doris returned home to find a fire had also started in a hallway closet of her house.
sentences.zh: 两天后，多丽丝回家发现自己家的走廊壁橱里也起了一场火。

sentences.en: Both Marie and Doris were unsure why they were being targeted.
sentences.zh: 玛丽和多丽丝都不明白为什么她们会成为目标。

sentences.en: They were friendly with one another but had no other ties.
sentences.zh: 她们彼此关系友好，但没有其他联系。

sentences.en: Following the arson attacks, Marie returned home to find an envelope attached to her front door.
sentences.zh: 纵火袭击发生后，玛丽回到家，发现前门上贴着一个信封。

sentences.en: It contained a note scrawled in tiny block letters that read,
sentences.zh: 里面有一张用微小印刷体涂写的便条，上面写着：

sentences.en: You are going to be sorry if you don't move.
sentences.zh: 如果不搬家，你们会后悔的。

sentences.en: The letter was taken by the police and Marie took to sleeping with a crowbar under her pillow.
sentences.zh: 这封信被警方带走了，玛丽开始枕着撬棍睡觉。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “档案案件”节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“档案案件”继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Then, in March 1979, Marie received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1979年3月，玛丽接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: An unidentified man told her that Frank, who had now been dead for well over three years, had owed him $10,000 in gambling debts.
sentences.zh: 一个身份不明的男子告诉她，已经去世三年多的弗兰克曾欠他1万美元的赌债。

sentences.en: The man expected to be paid despite Frank's passing.
sentences.zh: 尽管弗兰克已经去世，这名男子仍要求还钱。

sentences.en: He demanded a $5,000 down payment from Marie to be paid in cash.
sentences.zh: 他要求玛丽先支付5000美元的现金首付。

sentences.en: She was to place it in an envelope, then stash it behind cans of dog food in the town's main supermarket.
sentences.zh: 她必须把它放进信封里，然后藏在镇上主超市的狗粮罐后面。

sentences.en: He gave Marie a date and time for the drop-off and told her if she didn't pay, he would come for her daughter, Carol.
sentences.zh: 他给了玛丽交钱的日期和时间，并告诉她如果不付钱，他就会对她的女儿卡罗尔下手。

sentences.en: To Marie, this explained why the Hillies had been harassed and threatened in the years since Frank's death.
sentences.zh: 对玛丽来说，这解释了为什么希利一家在弗兰克去世后的几年里会遭到骚扰和威胁。

sentences.en: On the day of the drop-off, Marie visited the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 交钱的那天，玛丽来到了超市。

sentences.en: She headed down the pet care aisle and hid an envelope full of cash behind some cans of dog food.
sentences.zh: 她走向宠物护理过道，把装满现金的信封藏在一些狗粮罐后面。

sentences.en: Then she left.
sentences.zh: 然后她离开了。

sentences.en: A few people wandered down the aisle and some paused to browse iteMs.
sentences.zh: 几个人在过道里闲逛，还有人停下来浏览商品。

sentences.en: When the aisle was empty, a middle-aged man wearing a suit and tie appeared.
sentences.zh: 当过道空无一人时，出现了一个穿着西装系着领家中年男子。

sentences.en: After checking the coast was clear, he headed to the dog food and began searching the shelves.
sentences.zh: 在确认四周安全后，他径直走向狗粮区，开始在货架上搜寻。

sentences.en: He moved some packs of kibble out of the way, put them back, then turned his attention to the tins.
sentences.zh: 他把几包宠物干粮移开，放回去，然后把注意力转向了罐头。

sentences.en: He pulled several aside and continued his search.
sentences.zh: 他拉开几个罐头，继续搜寻。

sentences.en: He was unaware that several undercover police officers were watching.
sentences.zh: 他并不知道有几名便衣警察正在监视着他。

sentences.en: Some were acting like regular shoppers, while others kept tabs on the goings-on from unmarked cars outside.
sentences.zh: 一些人装扮成普通购物者，而另一些人则在外面无标志的汽车里关注着事态发展。

sentences.en: The drop was a sting operation orchestrated by the FBI, with Marie Hillie willingly playing her part.
sentences.zh: 这次交钱是一场由联邦调查局精心策划的钓鱼执法行动，玛丽·希利也自愿配合。

sentences.en: The envelope she had stashed was full of fake money.
sentences.zh: 她藏起来的信封里装满了假钞。

sentences.en: As the man in the suit was seemingly looking for it, a shopper turned into the aisle and made eye contact with him.
sentences.zh: 正当穿西装的男子似乎在寻找它时，一名购物者拐进了过道，与他目光交汇。

sentences.en: Looking awkward, the man thrust his hands into his pants pockets and walked off.
sentences.zh: 那男人显得有些尴尬，把双手插进裤兜，走开了。

sentences.en: As he hadn't found the envelope and proved himself as the extortionist, officers had no grounds to stop him.
sentences.zh: 由于他没有找到信封，也没有坐实敲诈勒索者的身份，警方没有理由拦住他。

sentences.en: They could only watch on as he left the store.
sentences.zh: 他们只能眼睁睁地看着他离开商店。

sentences.en: Yet, one recognised the man as a local business owner named Walter Clinton.
sentences.zh: 然而，其中一人认出这个男人是当地的一名企业主，名叫沃尔特·克林顿。

sentences.en: Police paid him a visit, during which Walter denied looking for any cash at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 警察找上了他，在此期间，沃尔特否认自己在超市里寻找过任何现金。

sentences.en: Ultimately, there was nothing to charge him with, so the matter was dropped.
sentences.zh: 最终，没有什么可以指控他的罪名，因此这件事情不了了之。

sentences.en: The demands of the extortionist targeting the Hillies had not been met.
sentences.zh: 针对希利一家的敲诈勒索者的要求并未得到满足。

sentences.en: As per his word, Carol Hillie would be his next target.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，卡罗尔·希利将成为他的下一个目标。

sentences.en: 19-year-old Carol was still living at the family home while studying at a local university.
sentences.zh: 19岁的卡罗尔一边在当地一所大学读书，一边仍然住在家里。

sentences.en: In April, one of her younger friends asked if Carol would be their date to prom.
sentences.zh: 4月份，她的一位年轻朋友问卡罗尔是否愿意做他们参加毕业舞会的舞伴。

sentences.en: She accepted the offer.
sentences.zh: 她接受了这个邀请。

sentences.en: After the dance, Carol attended a party where she drank a few cocktails and smoked some cannabis.
sentences.zh: 舞会结束后，卡罗尔参加了一个派对，在那里她喝了几杯鸡尾酒，还吸了一点大麻。

sentences.en: Then, she began to feel ill.
sentences.zh: 随后，她开始感到身体不适。

sentences.en: Thinking she had overindulged, Carol returned home and went to bed.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔以为自己有些乐极生悲，便回了家上床睡觉。

sentences.en: The next day, she was wracked by waves of nausea and vomiting.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她被一阵阵的恶心和呕吐折磨得痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: That afternoon, Carol was taken to the hospital, but all her tests came back clear.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，卡罗尔被送往医院，但她所有的检查结果都显示正常。

sentences.en: Over the following weeks, Carol was plagued with abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, headaches and fevers.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，卡罗尔饱受腹部绞痛、恶心、呕吐、头痛和发烧的折磨。

sentences.en: Doctors couldn't pinpoint the problem.
sentences.zh: 医生们无法找出问题所在。

sentences.en: Carol was offered a variety of antibiotics and painkillers, none of which helped.
sentences.zh: 医生给卡罗尔开了各种抗生素和止痛药，但都无济于事。

sentences.en: The usually outgoing Carol became withdrawn, depressed and hardly left the house.
sentences.zh: 平时性格外向的卡罗尔变得孤僻、消沉，几乎不出门。

sentences.en: Her weight plummeted, while her days were spent sleeping.
sentences.zh: 她的体重骤降，整天都在睡觉。

sentences.en: More hospital and doctor visits followed.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是更多次去医院和看医生。

sentences.en: It was suggested that Carol's condition was psychosomatic, caused or aggravated by a mental factor such as stress.
sentences.zh: 有人认为卡罗尔的病情是心身疾病，是由压力等心理因素引起或加重的。

sentences.en: One doctor believed she suffered from anorexia and her symptoms were the result of Carol starving herself.
sentences.zh: 一名医生认为她患有厌食症，她的症状是卡罗尔自我节食的结果。

sentences.en: At one point, Carol overdosed on paracetamol in an attempt to end her suffering.
sentences.zh: 有一次，卡罗尔为了结束痛苦，过量服用了扑热息痛。

sentences.en: She was subsequently admitted to a psychiatric facility, where she was prescribed sedatives and antidepressants and given vitamin injections.
sentences.zh: 她随后被送进了一家精神病院，在那里她被开了镇静剂和抗抑郁药，并接受了维生素注射。

sentences.en: During the stay, Carol's hands and feet became numb and she had difficulty walking.
sentences.zh: 在住院期间，卡罗尔的手脚变得麻木，走路也有些困难。

sentences.en: It got to the point where she couldn't even feed herself, as her extremities were non-functional.
sentences.zh: 严重到她甚至无法自己喂食，因为她的四肢已经失去功能。

sentences.en: Her mother had to spoon-feed Carol baby food, which was easier to swallow.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲不得不一勺一勺地喂卡罗尔吃婴儿食品，因为那样更容易吞咽。

sentences.en: When Carol suffered a fall, Marie decided she'd had enough.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗尔摔倒时，玛丽决定不再忍受下去了。

sentences.en: It had been five months since Carol's ordeal started and she was only getting worse.
sentences.zh: 距离卡罗尔的磨难开始已经过去五个月了，她的病情却越来越严重。

sentences.en: Against a doctor's recommendations, Marie removed Carol from the facility and took her to the nearby University of Alabama Hospital for a second opinion.
sentences.zh: 不顾医生的建议，玛丽将卡罗尔转出了该机构，并带她去了附近的阿拉巴马大学医院寻求第二诊疗意见。

sentences.en: Carol was promptly admitted to the neurology ward.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔很快被收入神经科病房。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Wednesday September 19, Marie was reading by Carol's hospital bed as her daughter slept.
sentences.zh: 9月19日星期三下午，趁女儿睡着时，玛丽正在卡罗尔的病床边看书。

sentences.en: Suddenly, there was a knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 突然，门响了敲门声。

sentences.en: Marie answered and stepped into the hall to speak with the visitors.
sentences.zh: 玛丽应声开门，走到走廊里与来访者交谈。

sentences.en: They were police officers acting on a warrant.
sentences.zh: 他们是持有搜查令的警察。

sentences.en: Marie Hilly was placed under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利被捕了。

sentences.en: Despite outwardly looking like a happy couple, tension had brewed between Marie and Frank Hilly in the years before his death.
sentences.zh: 尽管表面上看起来是一对幸福的夫妻，但在弗兰克去世前的几年里，玛丽和弗兰克·希利之间的关系一直很紧张。

sentences.en: Marie's love of high fashion and her desire to maintain a luxurious home burned through their earnings.
sentences.zh: 玛丽对高级时装的热爱以及她对维持奢华家居的渴望花光了他们的收入。

sentences.en: She also showered her children with pricey gifts.
sentences.zh: 她还给孩子们送昂贵的礼物。

sentences.en: Frank was easygoing and went out of his way to give Marie anything she wanted, but the growing financial burden strained their relationship.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克性格随和，想方设法满足玛丽想要的一切，但日益沉重的经济负担让他们的关系紧绷。

sentences.en: Frank once told a friend that,
sentences.zh: 弗兰克曾对朋友说过：

sentences.en: Marie can spend more money than anyone.
sentences.zh: 玛丽花钱大手大脚，无人能及。

sentences.en: She can spend more than I can make.
sentences.zh: 她花钱的速度比我赚钱的速度还快。

sentences.en: The couple's friends and family knew Marie lived well beyond her means, but were powerless to stop her.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的朋友和家人都知道玛丽的生活水平远超收入，却对此无能为力。

sentences.en: She was adept at spinning lies and making excuses to cover her tracks.
sentences.zh: 她擅长编造谎言和找借口来掩盖自己的行踪。

sentences.en: Following her husband's death,
sentences.zh: 丈夫去世后，

sentences.en: Marie sought other means to satisfy her expensive tastes.
sentences.zh: 玛丽寻找其他途径来满足她奢侈的品味。

sentences.en: Her arrest followed the discovery that she had written bad checks to a furniture company and obtained $6,500 under false pretenses from a bank.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，人们发现她向一家家具公司开出空头支票，并以欺骗手段从一家银行获得了6500美元，随后她便被捕了。

sentences.en: These were just two examples of years' worth of fraudulent activity conducted by Marie Hilly.
sentences.zh: 这只是玛丽·希利多年来欺诈行为的两个例子。

sentences.en: She owed thousands to local businesses and was behind on loan repayments.
sentences.zh: 她欠当地企业数千美元，贷款偿还也已经逾期。

sentences.en: She'd even gotten her son into debt, using him to co-sign multiple loans that she'd never repaid.
sentences.zh: 她甚至让儿子背上了债务，利用儿子共同签署多笔她从未偿还过的贷款。

sentences.en: When Marie failed to appear at a hearing for a fraud charge, contempt of court was added to her rap sheet.
sentences.zh: 当玛丽未能出庭应讯欺诈指控时，藐视法庭罪也被加到了她的犯罪记录中。

sentences.en: The extent of Marie's financial woes raised questions about the four-year-long harassment campaign waged against her family.
sentences.zh: 玛丽严重的财务困境引发了人们对针对她家持续四年的骚扰活动的质疑。

sentences.en: Significant investigations had been conducted to identify the perpetrator, but they went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 为了查明作案者，警方进行了大量调查，但都无果而终。

sentences.en: A lieutenant later told the Anniston Star newspaper,
sentences.zh: 一位中尉后来对《安尼斯顿星报》说：

sentences.en: There was a point in time when Marie would call me almost daily to report something.
sentences.zh: 曾有一段时间，玛丽几乎每天都会打电话给我汇报情况。

sentences.en: Harassing phone calls, people coming to her home, people stealing trivial things.
sentences.zh: 骚扰电话、有人来她家、有人偷走微不足道的东西。

sentences.en: After a period of time, things didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，事情变得有些说不通了。

sentences.en: A trace was placed on the Hilly's phone line.
sentences.zh: 希利家的电话线被安装了窃听装置。

sentences.en: It revealed that one of the nuisance calls Marie received was from a payphone outside her house.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，玛丽接到的一通骚扰电话来自她家外面的公用电话。

sentences.en: Every other time investigators tried to trace calls to the Hilly home, the calls would suddenly stop.
sentences.zh: 每次调查人员试图追踪打到希利家的电话时，电话就会突然挂断。

sentences.en: As soon as the tracing device was removed,
sentences.zh: 一旦追踪设备被移除，

sentences.en: Marie alerted police that the calls had started up again.
sentences.zh: 玛丽就会向警方报警，称电话又开始打进来了。

sentences.en: A trace was also placed on the phone line of her neighbour,
sentences.zh: 她的邻居的电话线也被安装了窃听装置，

sentences.en: Doris Ford, as she had also received nuisance calls.
sentences.zh: 即多丽丝·福特，因为她也接到过骚扰电话。

sentences.en: One no-talk call made to Doris was found to have originated from the office where Marie worked as a secretary.
sentences.zh: 经查，打给多丽丝的一通无声电话源自玛丽担任秘书的办公室。

sentences.en: Investigators came to suspect that Marie had orchestrated her own torment as a means of receiving insurance payouts.
sentences.zh: 调查人员开始怀疑玛丽是为了骗取保险金而自导自演了这场闹剧。

sentences.en: She'd tried unsuccessfully to sue the Alabama Gas Company for $75,000 following claims of a leak and received money after the fires that damaged her home.
sentences.zh: 她曾试图就泄漏事件起诉阿拉巴马天然气公司索赔75000美元，但以失败告终，并在其房屋受损的火灾后获得了赔偿。

sentences.en: In November 1977,
Carol's car was stolen from a shopping mall car park.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的汽车在购物中心停车场被偷。

sentences.en: It was found two hours later on fire.
sentences.zh: 两小时后，人们发现它着火了。

sentences.en: Marie collected an insurance claim that she had taken out on the vehicle shortly before it had been allegedly stolen.
sentences.zh: 玛丽领取了在这辆车据称被偷前不久为其购买的保险索赔。

sentences.en: Then there was the time
sentences.zh: 还有一次，

sentences.en: Marie claimed her harasser was a man chasing a debt left by her late husband.
sentences.zh: 玛丽声称她的骚扰者是一个追讨她已故丈夫留下的债务的男人。

sentences.en: While Marie blamed Frank's gambling addiction for her finance problems, there was zero evidence that he'd had a problem at all.
sentences.zh: 虽然玛丽将她的财务问题归咎于弗兰克的赌瘾，但没有任何证据表明他有什么赌瘾。

sentences.en: Marie's children believed
sentences.zh: 玛丽的孩子们认为，

sentences.en: Marie was the problematic gambler.
sentences.zh: 有赌瘾问题的人其实是玛丽。

sentences.en: She'd returned late at night with hundreds of extra dollars that she said was payment for late-night secretarial work.
sentences.zh: 她深夜返回时带了几百美元的额外现金，并声称那是深夜做秘书工作的报酬。

sentences.en: But her claims of extortion gained credence when local businessman Walter Clinton tried to collect a money drop that Marie left in a supermarket.
sentences.zh: 但当当地商人沃尔特·克林顿试图取走玛丽遗留在一家超市的一笔钱时，她关于勒索的说法开始变得可信。

sentences.en: When quizzed about his suspicious behaviour,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他可疑的行为时，

sentences.en: Walter revealed that he'd been following a tip-off he had received the night before.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特透露，他是根据前一天晚上收到的线报行事的。

sentences.en: Walter was engaged in a lawsuit against a former client and a woman called him to say she had documents that would help his case.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特当时正与一名旧客户打官司，一个女人打电话告诉他，她有能帮到他官司的文件。

sentences.en: She told him that she would leave them behind the tins of dog food at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她会把文件留在超市的狗粮罐后面。

sentences.en: When he couldn't find them, he left the store.
sentences.zh: 当他找不到文件时，便离开了商店。

sentences.en: Walter didn't recognise the voice of the woman who rang him as she had spoken in whispers.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特认不出打电话给他的那个女人的声音，因为她一直用耳语说话。

sentences.en: Marie Hilly knew about
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利知道

sentences.en: Walter Clinton's court case as she had previously been his secretary.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·克林顿的官司，因为她以前是他的秘书。

sentences.en: She also knew Walter on a more intimate level.
sentences.zh: 她和沃尔特还保持着更亲密的关系。

sentences.en: She'd been having an affair with him when Frank was alive.
sentences.zh: 在弗兰克还活着的时候，她就一直在和他鬼混。

sentences.en: The day Frank had abdominal pain and came home early from work, he found Walter and Marie in bed together.
sentences.zh: 在弗兰克腹痛、提早下班回家的那天，他发现沃尔特和玛丽躺在同一张床上。

sentences.en: By that time, he was too sick to address the matter.
sentences.zh: 那时，他已经病得无法处理这件事了。

sentences.en: Officers believed it was likely
sentences.zh: 警官们认为，

sentences.en: Marie Hilly had called Walter Clinton, embroiling her former employer and lover in a phony extortion bid she'd orchestrated to bolster her claiMs.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利很可能给沃尔特·克林顿打了电话，将她以前的老板兼情人卷入了一场她精心策划的虚假勒索中，以此来支撑她自己的说辞。

sentences.en: In a similar vein, she was deemed responsible for the harassment of her neighbour,
sentences.zh: 无独有偶，她也被认为是骚扰邻居的幕后黑手，

sentences.en: Doris Ford.
sentences.zh: 多丽丝·福特。

sentences.en: She likely hoped a second unrelated victim would make her own story seem more plausible.
sentences.zh: 她可能希望第二个不相关的受害者能让自己的谎言显得更加合理。

sentences.en: Despite receiving large insurance payouts,
sentences.zh: 尽管获得了大笔保险赔偿，

sentences.en: Marie denied any involvement in the criminal acts.
sentences.zh: 玛丽仍否认自己参与了这些犯罪行为。

sentences.en: Following her mother's arrest for fraud,
sentences.zh: 在母亲因涉嫌诈骗被捕后，

sentences.en: Carol Hilly was preparing for bed in her room at the University of Alabama Hospital when a doctor suddenly stopped by.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔·希利正准备在阿拉巴马大学医院的病房里睡觉，这时一名医生突然走了进来。

sentences.en: Carol was surprised to see him so late at night and even more so when he asked to examine her hands.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔很惊讶这么晚还看到他，而当他要求检查她的双手时，她就更惊讶了。

sentences.en: Running horizontally across each of Carol's fingernails were white lines.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔每根指甲上都横向延伸着白色的线条。

sentences.en: Known as Aldrich Mee's lines, they confirmed one thing.
sentences.zh: 这些被称为奥尔德里奇-米氏线，它们证实了一件事。

sentences.en: Carol's illness was the result of metal poisoning.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔的病情是金属中毒引起的。

sentences.en: The doctor had spoken with the physicians who'd treated Carol at the psychiatric facility prior to her arrival at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 这名医生曾与在卡罗尔到达这家医院之前治疗过她的精神科医生交谈过。

sentences.en: He'd learnt that Marie Hilly had made the snap decision to remove Carol from their care because there were discussions about Carol having metal poisoning.
sentences.zh: 他得知，由于有人讨论卡罗尔可能中了金属中毒，玛丽·希利当机立断决定将卡罗尔接走。

sentences.en: Everyone is exposed to the naturally occurring chemical element arsenic through a normal diet.
sentences.zh: 每个人在日常饮食中都会接触到天然存在的化学元素砷。

sentences.en: However, high enough amounts can be fatal.
sentences.zh: 然而，达到足够高的剂量可能是致命的。

sentences.en: Hair is one biomarker for arsenic exposure and when samples of Carol Hilly's hair were tested, it was found she had more than
sentences.zh: 头发是接触砷的一个生物标志物，当对卡罗尔·希利的头发样本进行检测时，发现她体内的砷含量超过了

sentences.en: 100 times the normal amount of arsenic in her body.
sentences.zh: 正常含量的100倍。

sentences.en: Marie Hilly was seen giving Carol injections throughout her daughter's months-long illness.
sentences.zh: 有人看到在女儿长达数月的病程中，玛丽·希利一直在给卡罗尔注射。

sentences.en: Marie said that she had received permission from Carol's doctor to do so and that the medicine would help with her nausea.
sentences.zh: 玛丽说，她得到了卡罗尔医生的允许才这么做的，而且这种药有助于缓解她的恶心。

sentences.en: She explained that she had sourced the medicine from their neighbour,
sentences.zh: 她解释说，药物是她从他们的邻居、

sentences.en: Doris Ford, who was a registered nurse.
sentences.zh: 注册护士多丽丝·福特那里获取的。

sentences.en: The needle's contents were cloudy and white.
sentences.zh: 针筒里的液体浑浊呈白色。

sentences.en: On one occasion,
sentences.zh: 有一次，

sentences.en: Marie administered
sentences.zh: 玛丽给

sentences.en: Carol's medicine orally.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔口服了药物。

sentences.en: The liquid was bubbly and it burned as Carol swallowed it.
sentences.zh: 液体带有气泡，卡罗尔吞咽时感到火辣辣的疼。

sentences.en: Marie made her daughter swear not to tell the staff about the medicine, saying that Doris would lose her job if she did.
sentences.zh: 玛丽让女儿发誓不要把药物的事告诉医护人员，并说如果她说了，多丽丝就会失业。

sentences.en: The revelation that Marie had likely been poisoning her daughter confirmed suspicions held by many of their friends and family.
sentences.zh: 玛丽可能一直在毒害自己女儿这一事实的曝光，证实了许多亲友心中的怀疑。

sentences.en: It wasn't an outrageous scenario to contemplate.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一个难以想象的剧本。

sentences.en: Carol had a tempestuous relationship with her mother.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔和母亲的关系十分紧张。

sentences.en: The pair fought often, mostly about
sentences.zh: 两人经常吵架，主要是关于

sentences.en: Carol smoking cannabis and being a lesbian, which Marie disapproved of.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔吸大麻和身为女同性恋，玛丽对这些行为很不赞同。

sentences.en: The previous year,
sentences.zh: 前一年，

sentences.en: Marie had taken out a $25,000 life insurance policy on Carol.
sentences.zh: 玛丽为卡罗尔购买了一份2.5万美元的人寿保险。

sentences.en: She was the sole beneficiary.
sentences.zh: 她是唯一的受益人。

sentences.en: Talk of poisoned injections got Mike Hilley thinking about his father.
sentences.zh: 关于毒针的议论让迈克·希利想到了他的父亲。

sentences.en: In hindsight, the symptoms
sentences.zh: 事后回想起来，

sentences.en: Frank Hilley had suffered were the same as arsenic poisoning.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·希利遭受的症状与砷中毒完全一样。

sentences.en: During the peak of Frank's illness, he was witnessed rubbing a swollen red pinprick in his upper arm.
sentences.zh: 在弗兰克病情最严重的时候，有人看到他揉搓着上臂一个红肿的针眼。

sentences.en: He said that Marie was giving him shots on doctor's orders and she had just administered one as practice.
sentences.zh: 他说，玛丽是奉医嘱给他打针，她刚刚打那一针只是在练习。

sentences.en: Frank died the next day.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克第二天就死了。

sentences.en: This didn't entirely explain his illness as he'd been unwell for some time and it appeared
sentences.zh: 这并不能完全解释他的病情，因为他已经病了一段时间了，而且看起来

sentences.en: Marie had only injected him once.
sentences.zh: 玛丽只给他注射过一次。

sentences.en: However, because liquid arsenic is clear and odourless, it was possible that she'd slipped it into his food or drink undetected.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于液态砷无色无味，她完全有可能在神不知鬼不觉的情况下把它掺进他的食物或饮料里。

sentences.en: With this in mind,
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，

sentences.en: Mike Hilley wrote to the coroner hoping to establish the truth.
sentences.zh: 迈克·希利写信给验尸官，希望能查明真相。

sentences.en: On Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 周三，

sentences.en: October 3, a crowd of spectators gathered at the
sentences.zh: 10月3日，大批旁观者聚集在

sentences.en: Forest Lawn Garden
sentences.zh: 森林草坪

sentences.en: Cemetery on the east side of town.
sentences.zh: 公墓，位于镇的东侧。

sentences.en: They watched on as police guided an excavator that was removing dirt from
sentences.zh: 他们看着警察指挥一台挖掘机清理

sentences.en: Frank Hilley's grave.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·希利坟墓上的泥土。

sentences.en: Frank's corpse bore hardly any signs of decomposition despite being buried for four years.
sentences.zh: 尽管已经埋葬了四年，但弗兰克的尸体几乎没有任何腐烂的迹象。

sentences.en: Arsenic also preserves body tissues.
sentences.zh: 砷也能防腐体内的组织。

sentences.en: A search of the hotel room where Marie Hilley had been staying during her daughter's hospitalisation uncovered a small bottle of clear odourless liquid inside a cosmetics case.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽·希利女儿住院期间居住的酒店房间里搜查时，人们在一个化妆箱里发现了一小瓶无色无味的液体。

sentences.en: It tested positive for arsenic.
sentences.zh: 经检测，砷呈阳性。

sentences.en: An empty brown medicine vial found inside
sentences.zh: 在逮捕后于

sentences.en: Marie's purse after her arrest had previously contained arsenic.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的手提包里发现的一个空棕色药瓶以前装的就是砷。

sentences.en: Arsenic was also the active ingredient in a bottle of rat and mouse poison stored amongst tins of baby food in Marie's home.
sentences.zh: 砷也是玛丽家中婴儿食品罐中存放的一瓶老鼠药的活性成分。

sentences.en: Marie Hilley was charged with the attempted murder of Carol Hilley, which she steadfastly denied.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利被指控谋杀卡罗尔·希利未遂，但她坚决否认。

sentences.en: The news sent shockwaves through the small community of Aniston.
sentences.zh: 这一消息在安尼斯顿这个小社区引起了轩然大波。

sentences.en: A family friend told reporters,
sentences.zh: 一位家族朋友告诉记者，

sentences.en: The Hilley's were just a typical family.
sentences.zh: 希利一家只是一个典型的家庭。

sentences.en: Big churchgoers.
sentences.zh: 经常去教堂。

sentences.en: You'd never have thought anything like this would happen to them.
sentences.zh: 你绝不会想到这种事会发生在他身上。

sentences.en: Marie Hilley was initially held on a $14,000 bond.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·希利最初被以1.4万美元的保释金拘留。

sentences.en: Her lawyer, a man named
sentences.zh: 她的律师，一个名叫

sentences.en: Wilford Lane, successfully petitioned five locals to come up with the money and Marie was subsequently freed.
sentences.zh: 威尔福德·莱恩的人，成功说服了五位当地人凑齐了这笔钱，随后玛丽被释放。

sentences.en: With the help of Wilford, she used a fake name to book into a hotel where she was to lie low until her day in court.
sentences.zh: 在威尔福德的帮助下，她用假名登记入住了一家酒店，准备在那里避风头，直到出庭受审的那天。

sentences.en: Six days later,
sentences.zh: 六天后，

sentences.en: Wilford arrived at Marie's hotel room to discuss her upcoming trial.
